claim: Cambridge C1 Advanced (C1 Advanced) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs as evidence of English language proficiency for visa purposes (from 7 Aug 2025)
caveats: DHA instrument specifies C1 Advanced as an accepted English test (excludes "vocational English" category).

claim: Canadian English Language Proficiency Index Program General (CELPIP General) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs as evidence of English proficiency for visas (from 7 Aug 2025)
IELTS Academic (including One Skill Retake) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs for visa English proficiency (valid from 7 Aug 2025)
caveats: DHA requires minimum IELTS Academic score 6.0 in each component for competent English. Admissions often require 6.5+.

claim: IELTS General Training (including One Skill Retake) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs for visa English proficiency (from 7 Aug 2025)
PTE Academic is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs as evidence of English proficiency for visas (from 7 Aug 2025)
caveats: DHA competent English requires PTE scores ≥47 listening, 48 reading, 51 writing, 54 speaking (sum equivalence to IELTS 6.0).

claim: TOEFL iBT (in-person, at authorised test centres) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs for visa English proficiency
caveats: TOEFL iBT Australia at an authorised centre is recognised by DHA for visa purposes; Home Edition scores are NOT accepted.

claim: Occupational English Test (OET) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs as evidence of English proficiency for visas (from 7 Aug 2025)
caveats: OET scores (B in each component) meet DHA competent English. Nepal centres for OET are not yet established (TBD).

claim: LANGUAGECERT Academic is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs for visa English proficiency (from 7 Aug 2025)
caveats: DHA competent English requires LanguageCert scores Listening 57, Reading 60, Writing 64, Speaking 70 (new since Aug 2025). Nepal availability unclear.

claim: Michigan English Test (MET) is accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs as evidence of English proficiency for visas (from 7 Aug 2025)
caveats: DHA competent English requires MET scores Listening 56, Reading 55, Writing 57, Speaking 48. MET test centres in Nepal are very limited (if any).

claim: Duolingo English Test is not accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs for student visa (subclass 500) purposes
caveats: Duolingo DET is accepted by some universities for admissions, but DHA explicitly does NOT accept it for visas (students must use IELTS/PTE/TOEFL).

claim: British Council offers IELTS tests in nine Nepal locations: Banepa, Biratnagar, Birtamode, Butwal, Chitwan, Ghorahi, Itahari, Kathmandu and Pokhara
caveats: British Council IELTS Nepal centres (as of 2026) span all regions listed. IDP operates additional centres (overlap at Biratnagar, Pokhara, Kathmandu).

claim: IDP Education Nepal operates four IELTS test centres: Biratnagar, Chitwan (Bharatpur), Pokhara, and Kathmandu
caveats: IDP’s official listing shows four centres. Biratnagar, Chitwan, Pokhara, Kathmandu. No IDP centre in Birgunj was found (contradicts some sources).

claim: Alfa Beta Institute (Kathmandu) is the only PTE Academic test centre in Nepal
caveats: Alfa Beta (New Baneshwor, Kathmandu) opened Nepal’s first PTE test centre. No other PTE centres were operating in Nepal (per that source).

claim: TOEFL iBT (in-person) is offered at authorized test centres in Nepal, including Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Chitwan
caveats: ETS lists Nepal for TOEFL iBT. Local sources (TheAOneGlobal) report test venues in Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Chitwan. (For accuracy use ETS finder.)

claim: TOEFL iBT exam fee in Nepal is USD 180 (approximately NPR 23,967)
caveats: TheAOneGlobal cites USD 180 (~NPR 23,967) for TOEFL iBT in Nepal. (University programs may have separate fee if taken under Australian ETS with different pricing.)

claim: The TOEFL iBT Home Edition (online-from-home) is not accepted by the Australian Department of Home Affairs for visa purposes
caveats: DHA requires TOEFL iBT to be taken at an approved test centre; Home Edition scores are explicitly not accepted for visa applications.

claim: TOEFL iBT (in-person) is recognized by 100% of Australian universities and accepted for Australian visa purposes when taken at an authorized test center
caveats: According to ETS, the TOEFL iBT Australia test (taken at an authorized center) is accepted by 100% of Australian universities and by DHA for visa purposes.

claim: The fee for IELTS Academic (on computer) at the IDP Biratnagar test centre is NPR 36,000 (2026)
caveats: IDP’s official site lists NPR 36,000 for the computer-based IELTS Academic fee at Biratnagar. (Other centres may charge similar; previous sources (2023) cited ~28-30k, indicating an increase.)

claim: Australia Awards Scholarship recipients receive full tuition fees paid by the Australian government
caveats: For Nepal, Awards are for Masters courses only; recipients must meet DFAT eligibility and return to Nepal for min 2 years (noted policy).

claim: Australia Awards Scholarship recipients receive return economy air travel between Nepal and Australia
Australia Awards Scholarship includes a contribution to living expenses (stipend) for recipients
caveats: Amounts follow DFAT policy (approx AUD 31,000/yr for Masters); updated annually.

claim: Australia Awards Scholarship includes overseas student health cover (OSHC) for the duration of the scholarship
Australia Awards Scholarships for Nepal (commencing 2027 intake) open 1 Feb 2026 and close 30 Apr 2026
caveats: Dates for 2027 intake (apply in 2026). (2026 intake likely had similar timeline: 1 Feb–30 Apr 2025.)

claim: Destination Australia Scholarships provide AUD 15,000 per year to eligible international students studying at a regional campus
caveats: Over 1000 scholarships are offered each year nationwide. Eligibility typically requires studying in a regional area.

claim: University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships provide eligible international research students with a living allowance and tuition remission
entity: University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarship
caveats: Applicants are automatically considered; over 300 such scholarships (living stipend and/or fee waiver) are awarded to international graduate researchers each year.

claim: The University of Melbourne offers more than 300 Graduate Research Scholarships to international graduate students annually
entity: University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarship
caveats: These scholarships include living allowances and tuition remission.

claim: The University of Sydney awards over AUD $135 million in scholarships annually to domestic and international students
caveats: Includes various awards (e.g. Vice-Chancellor's, merit scholarships). (Specific schemes have separate criteria and deadlines.)

claim: Australia Awards Scholarships (Nepal) are offered for Master’s programs only (Master’s by coursework or by research)
caveats: Nepalese Awards do not fund PhDs or undergraduate degrees. Applicants must meet country-specific criteria.
